nom: Paula's Choice Resist Super-Light Wrinkle Defense Spf 30

avis.texte: Wow, this product is pretty amazing. I have very pale, very sensitive, combination skin (yay me!) and I have struggled for years to find something that would give me SPF coverage without causing a reaction or breakout. I also want a cruelty free, vegan, and as natural as possible of a product, so options have been limited. To think of the money I have wasted on products that not only didn't deliver what I hoped they would, but also caused more stress and damage to my skin, has made me very cautious of purchasing outside of the products I know work for me. I love Osea Malibu products, but they don't make a face lotion with SPF, or any kind of makeup. While I love Sun Bum for my body, the face lotion with SPF leaves me greasy and has caused some allergic reactions and breakouts. I thought I was doomed to be battling breakouts or worse, stuck in the shade, and then I found this beauty! I have tried so many face lotions with SPF that either caused me to be very greasy and break out or didn't provide enough SPF coverage. This product is like a BB cream, only better. It provides you with amazing matte coverage, and after testing it in direct and very bright sunlight for 30 minutes I can attest that the SPF does indeed provide good protection. And best of all, no breakouts since I started using it about a week ago. I know my skin, and if I did have an issue with this product it would have shown up right away. For those with combination and oily complexions this product should work r

Paula's Choice RESIST Super-Light Daily Wrinkle Defense SPF 30 Matte Tinted Face Moisturizer has become an integral part of my skincare routine, and I am delighted to give it a well-deserved 5-star rating. This exceptional product combines sun protection, moisturization, and a flawless matte finish, resulting in radiant and protected skin. One of the standout features of this face moisturizer is its broad-spectrum SPF 30 protection. Sun protection is crucial in maintaining healthy and youthful-looking skin, and Paula's Choice RESIST delivers just that. Its high SPF shields my skin from harmful UVA and UVB rays, reducing the risk of sun damage and premature aging. Knowing that my skin is well-protected gives me peace of mind throughout the day. The lightweight and non-greasy formula of this moisturizer is another reason for its exceptional rating. It effortlessly glides onto the skin, leaving behind a smooth and matte finish. Unlike many other tinted moisturizers, Paula's Choice RESIST does not feel heavy or clog my pores. It allows my skin to breathe while providing essential hydration, creating a perfect canvas for makeup application or for a natural, no-makeup look. The subtle tint in this moisturizer provides a beautiful sheer coverage, evening out my skin tone and blurring imperfections. It gives my skin a healthy and radiant appearance without feeling or looking heavy. I appreciate the versatility of this product, as it saves me time by combining the benefits of moisturi

I'm not going to touch on the size, because I knew I was purchasing a travel size. After trying this and loving it (at first) I actually purchased a full tube direct from the PC website. I really thought I had found my HG sunscreen. The Pros: no white cast. This matches my skin tone (very fair with strong pink undertones) about as perfectly as I've been able to find. I normally hate mineral sunscreen because of the white cast, but no issues with the PC Resist. It spreads very nicely and dries down matte, eliminating the shine I get on my forehead, nose, and chin. It doesn't sting or irritate my sensitive eyes. It contains resveratrol, which has natural estrogenic properties, great for aging skin. Now to the Cons: It leaves a waxy residue when you try to wash it off, requiring a double cleanse with an oil-based product. That's no big deal normally, but I have been having major irritation that I know is from the sunscreen. I don't feel it when I'm wearing it necessarily, other than I can tell my face feels a bit dry. However, after using an oil cleanser to break up the zinc oxide, and then my regular gentle facewash, my face is on FIRE! So irritated and raw feeling. Last night my entire face was bright red and burned for hours afterward. I do not rub or scrub at my face while washing, so it's not a mechanical issue. These are also products I've had in my regimen for years, so no allergy issue with them. I also noticed my skin felt very, very smooth after removing the sunscreen,

avis.titre: Lightweight tinted sunscreen that mattifies and evens skin tone
avis.texte: I purchased the larger bottle last year and didn’t really use it until recently. I apply moisturizer, Hourglass primer, this, and another tinted moisturizer like NARS over it. This does mattify your face, dries down well and does a good job of neutralizing slight redness. I’m 55 and feel like I want to take using sunscreen more seriously where before I wasn’t layering spf products. I’m a very fair dry skinned redhead that burns. I think this product adds a nice layer of protection without a noticeable smell. It doesn’t clog pores or cause breakouts. It would work well on its own but don’t expect it to miraculously cover everything although it evens your complexion. Order the bigger size as it’s a better value. You only need a small amount. It spreads evenly with just your fingers. It will look much darker when you squeeze it out than it appears once applied.

I LOVE this sunscreen. It’s high in zinc oxide, goes on with a very light texture, and does what no other sunscreens do as well: dries down quickly and completely. Once it’s set, it feels like absolutely nothing. I think it could reasonably be called an oil-control sunscreen, as it prevents my oily skin “breakthrough” for longer than any other I’ve tried, and slightly longer than no sunscreen at all. The zinc I mentioned can also help reduce oil production over time (peer-reviewed large-scale data) which is an added bonus. I really can’t praise the texture enough. As someone who prefers a light dusting of powder foundation and maybe some spot concealer, this is the one and only sunscreen I’ve ever used that doesn’t bog down my powder foundation. As with all Paula’s Choice products, it is available in a sample/travel size, which is fantastic for trying out. Every company should do this, and it’s frankly stupid that so few do. Another usual PC bonus is that it is non-irritating. My skin’s pretty sensitive, and it’s never caused any problems anywhere, even on my eyelids. There are some caveats: - The price is preposterous. Points for using all the standard sunscreen ingredients in such an unprecedented formula - but simultaneously, the same ingredients are in most sunscreens and don’t justify the cost. Any company could’ve developed this (so shame on them for not identifying the market). - The rapid dry-down means there’s no time to play about. It goes on, it gets blended out, a

I really like the product (high zinc oxide concentration, silicone base, non-comedogenic), but there are a few downsides that prevent it from being great, in my view: -1- This product is *matte*. That said, my skin is combination, with an oily T-zone, and I'd actually prefer something a tiny bit more dewy/radiant . . . and this is coming from someone who was deliberately trying to avoid sunscreens that were too shiny/glowy. I'm going to try experimenting by adding moisturizer before applying this one. -2- The tint is a nice color: light tan with a rosy undertone. Given how sheer the product is, it does apply almost invisibly onto the skin, but since I am very fair, it does darken my skin ever so slightly. That said, it is still lighter in color than many competing products like the Epionce or Bliss, so I can't complain too much. I'll update my review if my sentiments change.
Lightweight and non- greasy. This product is tinted just enough to go on my light to medium skin and not really show up.
Sooo good! Helps your skin glow and feel like it’s doing its job! Not greasy, light coverage, sunscreen, doesnt break me out and I’m def a breaker outer!
Pl. Sell this product again. Good one. Why is there no production?
Truly overpriced. Its a tiny tube shorter than my index finger. Could barely use it once. Be careful!

J’ai vu ce produit recommandé par une influenceuse pour la rosacée et la peau sensible. C’est effectivement le cas. Ma peau ne devient pas grasse avec cette crème, et mes rougeurs n’augmentent pas (elles reduisent mêmes on dire). Texture agréable, ne coule pas dans les yeux. Excellent pour un usage de tous les jours. La crème a une légère teinte mais ne permet pas de camoufler autant que La Roche Posay mineral. Toutefois, j’ai l’impression que mes rougeurs sont plus importantes en fin de journée avec La Roche Posay. Définitivement je vais racheter la crème Paula’s. Elle vaut la différence de prix.

This is my 'holy grail' after many years of searching for the perfect daily facial sunscreen..this is 'the one' I have very oily skin, I've always battled with shine. I've tried many..many facial sunscreens, and spent a lot of money in the process, but no more! This is perfect for me. Beautiful texture, super lightweight, matte finish without looking 'flat'. It doesn't crease or settle in fine lines. I'm not one for sitting out in the sun but I've never burnt with this on my face and neck. I wear it daily, all year round. It's a brilliant product!

Excellent for mature, yet oily skin and provides “your skin but better” coverage. It does feel wet going on and at first it feels like it’s not going to dry down, but within a few minutes it does and it provides a matte/satin finish. (It’s not full matte finish and looks more natural). It does have dimethicone and hydrated silica, which usually look matte at first, but then make me even oilier after a few hours, but whatever they do with this formulation works for me. This is the only product I have ever used that has kept my skin relatively matte the entire day. I have a fair to light warm tone/undertone and this does lean toward a pinkish, neutral, yet it is light enough coverage and blends in well enough that it isn’t a problem (I do wish it was a touch more warm, though). Oh, and I wear a lot of products underneath this, and it does not pill (but I don’t wear anything over it so I can’t speak to that). The attached picture is of me with the product on. I forgot to take a picture this morning before applying it to show up before and after. But you can see that it is very light coverage, isn’t patchy, and as a close enough match.

avis.titre: Great tinted spf for fair to light skintones
avis.texte: I am a devoted user of Paula's Choice skincare products. I used to have oily skin and this became my holy grail facial sunscreen, not only because of that but because so many one-color spf tints are too dark or orangey on me. I'm fair skinned and usually use the 2nd lightest of most foundations on the slightly warmer side. As I'm getting older, now 65, I do layer some products underneath it, Paula's Vit C cream and her Triple Active. They keep me from drying out and being too matte. Somehow, though this color is very neutral to almost cool, it makes me look healthy and balances out my otherwise sallow warm yellow undertone. Probably it works alright because it's quite sheer and natural. I keep coming back to this one as my daily casual look. It never creeps into pores or wrinkles either.

avis.titre: Not sure of ill buy again but its nice
avis.texte: First I want to say this is a great SPF option for oily skin when you want a very light skin tint. Im naturally oily skin, but since using tretnoin, my skin is dry. Due to my skin being dry, I do need to pair it with another moisturizer under. Most spf moisturizers make my face look extremely greasy, and this one does not, it gives a nice natural finish. The skin tint on it is very light, so its a good option considering i dont wear foundation ever and suffer from accent.

avis.titre: HOLY GRAIL BUY IF U GOT OILY SKIN LIKE ME !!!
avis.texte: MY HOLY GRAIL ! I have forever been searching for a sunscreen/moisturizer that left a real matte finish . This is the only sunscreen I've been able to find that truly IS MATTE and stays on matte practically the whole day unless I'm sweating because it's hot or in the process of working out ! I also love this because of the tint it leaves ! I am very gentle when applying this and add a generous amount that that will cover any little dark spots and acne I have because I don't always want to wear a full beat of makeup daily soo this helps a lot and once it dries down for a tiny bit of extra coverage I'll spot conceal only and it does the trick on my face to perfect ! Get this is you was oily skin trust mee <3 I'll add photo of me just with the sunscreen and a tiny bit of spot conceal and then it over a full beat of makeup on the second and no oil

avis.titre: I wanted to like this but It turned my skin yellow
avis.texte: I have recently been told I have Rosacea and have been looking for creams that are gentle on my face/skin. I ordered this hoping it would work on my face as a gentle sunscreen. I really wanted this to work. I tried it on my arm first, 30 minutes before going out in the sun/shade (mostly shade). I was out for maybe an hour in my vegetable garden and when I came in, I noticed both arms had yellow blotchy patches in them. It washed off with regular hand soap and water but I have no idea why this happened - glad I didn't put it on my face. I didn't want to give a bad review because I really like other products by this seller - I love the Calming Cleanser which I use every night before bed to wash off my makeup. I don't know how to rate the sun protection/moisturizing features because I only used it once, but it seemed to spread on ok - it was thinner than I expected but that's not a bad thing if it protects from sun despite being thin.

avis.titre: The best spf moisturizer I’ve found so far
avis.texte: I’ve tried a bunch of spf moisturizers and for the most part did not keep with them for a variety of reasons including being too drying, too much residue, making me sheet white/ sickly looking, too oily/ greasy, making me breakout or itchy. This one, while not perfect has been the best yet as it is the least oily, is lightweight, applies evenly, not drying, doesn’t make me breakout or itchy and overall good for sensitive skin but also it has a slight tint which is at least better than no tint. I will say I am naturally very pale compared to most people so this works for me and even for myself, I wish it gave a bit more color but it doesn’t make me look sick, it just looks natural on my face. I’ve also learned to apply moisturizer underneath and then this spf tint applies much smoother. And if I want some color, I will add a bronzer powder on top of it. I do use it every morning after I’ve washed my face and I like it. I like that it’s made of zinc oxide meaning mineral based as opposed to a chemical based sunscreen and 30 spf is enough protection from sun damage for me for daily wear. It’s also very inexpensive compared to others I’ve tried which is an added bonus. It’s close to perfect for me and I’ve tried nearly all the drug store ones, Elta MD, PCA skin, Cerave, cetaphil, Obagi, Skinceuticals, Dermatologica, Revision and a few others. I’m pretty happy with it. I’m on my 3rd tube.

This is the travel size option. I love Paula’s choice. It never makes my rosacea flare. I wanted to test this out before buying the full size option. I like how thin and silky it feels. I hate feeling heavy after most tinted SPF moisturizers. I would rather it be a satin or dewy finish but I plan to just wear this under a serum foundation that is dewy so it doesn’t bother me too much. Not much of a scent which is nice for everyday wear. Would recommend. ⭐️
How on Earth is this 20 dollars? This is the size of a sample. Wow
I love Paula's choice products. But for the price of this, I guess I was expecting the item to be a little bigger

avis.titre: Travel size is tiny! More like sample size
avis.texte: Literally fits into the palm of my hand and I have a normal sized hand. Other than that has a nice tint and feels smooth on.
Feels great on my face with the perfect amount of coverage. Very light! It's my new favorite makeup, face cream, face sunscreen, all-in-one!

I haven’t used it yet because it literally just got delivered less than 10 minutes ago. But I just want to warn people that the size of the product is 2 fl. Oz. I did not expect that when I ordered a $37 sunscreen/moisturizer combo. Yes, it’s my fault for not being more thorough but I hope I can prevent others from making the same mistake.

I bought Paula's choice from a verified vendor before and love it. Saw it on Amazon and decided to get it. The one I got looks like the picture on here, but not my bottle/the one on Paula's Choice website. Amazon's (the one on the right) is missing the logo, has a less bold font, and the guarantee (grey area) is differently worded. That being said, I put it on my face for the first time a few minutes ago. It doesn't seem to cover the red quite as well, but my face is not melting off either.... I'll probably buy a bottle from Paula's Choice directly soon.

I bought this thinking it was going to be trustworthy for sensitive skin based on the reviews, and quite frankly, the price. I still did a skin test to be sure and all went well. Once I put it on my face, things went south. I drove to work (about 20 min drive) after applying this before I went out the door. I noticed my face is was itchy in a few spots. When it didn’t fade and my face started to go numb, I looked in the mirror and found my cheeks looked like this. I have taken medicine, washed my skin thoroughly, and am still in quite a bit of pain. I’ll be going to urgent care soon if it doesn’t let up.

I was very excited about the reviews for this product but unfortunately I was one of the people who broke out in a rash after my first use. I liked the formula, it had a good feeling when I put it on my skin and was v lightweight for a mineral sunscreen. With a spray tan it was definitely too light so if u have medium to dark skin tone I don’t think this would blend well. BUT worst of all, I have red, itchy, inflamed hives all over my face + now that they’re healing it is dry and itchy. The fine print says “discontinue use if rash occurs.” Sigh. Very expensive for something known to irritate certain skin types. :/

avis.titre: Don’t bother with the smaller size.
avis.texte: While I believe this product might be good(this is my first day using it), and as I understand this is travel size, this wouldn’t last more than 2-3 days max. For $10 I would expect something a little larger that what I could only imagine was made for a church mouse. (Ps I don’t have large sized man hands.) But I will for sure be carrying it in my tic-tac container sized purse when I go out.

avis.titre: Overpriced and Tiny Not Worth It!
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this sunscreen, but I’m beyond disappointed. The bottle is ridiculously tiny for the price! I feel like I paid for a deluxe sample rather than a full-sized product. It’s not practical for regular use, as I’d run out in no time. While the formula itself seems decent, the size just doesn’t justify the cost. Definitely not worth it!

Este producto ya no sirve, al principio era muy bueno y cubría un poco las imperfecciones, ahora es demasiado grasoso y no cubre nada Ya no lo compro más. No sé si era falso o cambió su consistencia y presentación.

I was excited to buy this after reading many positive reviews. Unfortunately, I was very surprised to find that this product rates poor in the app I use to find healthy products. I will be returning, as finding safe & healthy products for my skin is of absolute importance.

Did a test on my hands: my right has no product and my left hand has the product rubbed in and let sit for 5 minutes. The moisturizer immediately made my skin shiny, it made my skin look tanner which I like but brought out the wrinkles and made my skin look older and leathery. It feels heavy like foundation and I’m going to try to get a refund.

This sunscreen is the only new thing I added to my routine. It caused a weird rash I have never had before. I feel bummed cause it’s too late to return it. If you have acne prone sensitive skin, AVOID

avis.titre: Don't bother buying the travel size
avis.texte: The smaller size is a joke, it's the size you would get a free sample of something in. Just go ahead and purchase the larger version if interested. Picture included for reference, notecard for comparison.

I should have paid more attention to the actual size of the $10 travel size because this is INSANELY small. Had to return. 0.5 fl oz for $10 is actually pretty crazy.. it looks more like a sample to me. Although Ive heard great things about the formula, I had to return without trying it.
When I opened the package, there was cream all over the cap, no sealing and the bottle itself was dirty.
I don’t actually know if it’s good or not. Received the bottle which looks like it was used. I thought maybe it leaked but it was in plastic wrap with nothing in it. Really weird.

avis.titre: $10 for a sample size what a joke
avis.texte: It’s the size of my index finger and I have tiny hands. I would’ve just gotten the larger size instead of wasting my money on something that looks like I’ll get 3 uses out of it.

I love how well this product is safety sealed. I have read some great reviews about this and decided to give it a try. I have used Australian Gold tinted spf 50 in light shade for a few years now so I posted pictures of the tint shades for comparison. This PC is definitely more of a natural feel as opposed to the AG being very mattifying. I’m a combination dry skin w occasional oil on nose, so I do enjoy the more natural feel. However I still wear a lightweight moisturizer before applying any sunblock. The PC is very pale, even for my fair complexion. I have to apply a little dusting of non shimmering light colored bronzer so I don’t look ill. That’s how pale it is on my face. But if I’m wearing it under foundation that isn’t an issue. It also wears really great under foundation and acts like a primer. I will definitely finish using my tube and may purchase again because I really do love the natural finish, I only wish it didn’t look that pale so on lazy days I could wear it by itself. For reference I usually wear the second to lightest shade of any foundation.

avis.titre: 3 months use, no help! Discovered it isn't good too late
avis.texte: Leaves a nice glow but not effective. read up on it too late.

avis.titre: Protector solar como base de maquillaje
avis.texte: Me encantó este artículo. Ahora ya no más base de maquillaje.

This is my one of my favorite items from Paula's Choice. It is also the best sunscreen for many reasons: 1. It has a tint to it that has the coverage of a BB cream which is pretty good if you want a little coverage also it means NO WHITE CAST. 2. It is completely matte. I have very oily skin and I have tried many other moisturizers (Cetaphil Oil Control moisturizer & Shiseido Pureness Matifying Moisturizer) that claim to be mattefying but I would still end up with oily skin by the end of the day. This matte finish last ALL DAY. 3. It has zinc oxide which means it's physical sunscreen which is better than chemical sunscreens if your skin breaks out from that. 4. Does not have that SPF smell at all. Note: The reason I said its the best sunscreen as oppose to best moisturizer is because it does not hydrate like a moisturizer. I would definitely not recommend this for dry skin. I have combination skin so on the dry areas or when I have dry patches on my face I avoid putting this one those areas because as I've said its VERY mattefying. But if you have oily skin this should work as your morning moisturizer. I personally still put something more hydrating underneath for days when I'm feeling dry.

avis.titre: My favorite acne-safe SPF for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I recently switched to this after using Elta MD UV Clear SPF 46 for a long time. I try to use everything noncomedogenic and fragrance free, etc, and discovered the Elta MD may actually be triggering my skin. I am SO glad I made the switch to the Paula's Choice SPF. The application is much lighter. This is the best texture physical SPF I have used, hands down. The closest one in texture was probably Tula Mineral Magic, if you've tried it, but that one felt a bit greasy on the skin and broke me out. Definitely adding this to subscribe & save 😁The one downside is the lower SPF in this sunscreen compared to Elta MD, but I'm just so in love with how light the application is for this and how much my skin likes it, that I'm happy to reapply.

Honestly, I love this brand so much! I love that the bottle is travel size so I can take it with me to the beach or the pool easily. I've had this bottle for a while now and I'm just now getting to the end of it! It doesn't have a scent, and it doesn't irritate my skin which was the most important thing for me. It does have a slight tint which I appreciate, and it genuinely helps with preventing sunburn on my face, I notice a huge difference when using this! Plus, it has wrinkle defense? What more could you ask for.

avis.titre: BEST spf I've had for face!
avis.texte: I got the travel size to try. Yes; it's basically the size of a deluxe sample and expensive. But Paula's Choice products are expensive in general so I wasn't too shocked by the size for $16. It's a great product. Feels great on the skin. Not heavy. It's tinted in a "no white cast" way not a "foundation" way but it's enough to smooth out my complexion overall. I will be buying a full size after this!

avis.titre: The BEST sunscreen for oily skin
avis.texte: I have very oily, sensitive and acne prone skin. This sunscreen is my holy grail. It’s amazing alone or under makeup. It stays pretty matte by itself but it really stays matte if I wear bare minerals foundation powder over top of it. Of course I still get a bit oily because that’s how my skin is but it’s noticeably less with this product. If I don’t rub it in well it does look kind of pale on my skin but it blends in really well if I rub it in pretty good. It has very very light coverage kind of like a bb cream but it’s not cakey or anything. The texture is silky smooth but not oily or heavy. I do use moisturizer before putting on this sunscreen. I will be purchasing again 💯
This beauty item highly recommend for oily and combination skin type. I am an aesthetician licensed and this light product with spf of 30 should be part of your routine makeup.
I never write reviews, but I felt compelled to write one. $18 for a travel sized product is absolutely ridiculous. I’m so disappointed.
Advertised as 1 fluid ounce and the shipment I received was half that .05.
